english.meaning: to do something stubbornly, even when it is unwelcome
english.note: Placed before the verb: 監生要唱, insists on singing. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Then, ha, he harassed the passengers again, insisting on singing them his ten theme songs.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉呢又，喀，又騷擾啲乘客。監生要唱佢十隻主題曲俾啲乘客聽。
